iut_type: TCW application review process -- after Submission, SIG separately reviews and approves (or rejects) the Test Case Waiver application, with direct notification to the registrant
customer_question: Now that the registration confirmation (Submission) operation has been completed, what happens next, and what should we expect regarding cost processing and further steps?
question_variants: Is a TCW automatically accepted once entered during registration, or does it go through a separate review?
Who receives notification of a TCW application's outcome -- the registrant, or the proxy registration company?
actual_issue: After the registration Submission operation was completed by the proxy registration company, the customer wanted to understand what further processing steps remained before the registration would actually be complete and publicly visible, particularly regarding a Test Case Waiver (TCW) that had been applied during the registration.
plain_english_explanation: Completing the Submission operation does not immediately finalize the registration when a TCW has been applied -- instead, SIG's administrators separately review and approve (or, in principle, reject) the TCW application after Submission, a process that typically takes 1 to 5 business days. Only after this TCW approval does the registration actually complete and become publicly visible. Critically, the registrant (the company under whose name the registration is filed) receives SIG's notification of the TCW application's approval or rejection directly -- not solely through the proxy registration company -- so the registrant should expect and watch for this notification themselves, separate from any status updates from their registration support provider.
consultant_answer: Completing Submission isn't the final step when a TCW is involved -- SIG's administrators separately review and approve the TCW application afterward, typically within 1 to 5 business days, after which the registration actually completes and becomes publicly visible. You'll receive SIG's notification of the TCW approval (or rejection) directly yourselves, so please watch for that as well as any updates from us.
decision_logic: When a registration involves a TCW application, explain to the customer that Submission completion is not the final step -- SIG separately reviews and approves (or rejects) the TCW afterward (typically 1-5 business days), and that the registrant will receive this approval/rejection notification directly from SIG, not only through the proxy registration company.
final_recommendation: After completing a Submission that included a TCW application, proactively explain the separate SIG-side TCW review/approval step and its typical turnaround time, and let the customer know they'll receive SIG's notification directly, to avoid confusion about why the registration isn't immediately and fully complete right after Submission.
risk_if_done_wrong: A customer unaware that Submission completion doesn't immediately finalize a TCW-involving registration might be confused or alarmed by a delay, or might miss SIG's direct notification of approval or rejection if they aren't expecting to receive it themselves.
